<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/spec`, touching **84** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **39** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/api-surface/data.json`, `packages/spec/api-surface/kernel.json`, `packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json`, …), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**22** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 5e706e7a9e938925de326ed52b6d65475f43d095`.

⛔ **10** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **39** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/api-surface/data.json`, `packages/spec/api-surface/kernel.json`, `packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **34** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **60** of **212** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **168** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 5e706e7a9e938925de326ed52b6d65475f43d095` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `bfbecfe77b5507f481e0fbe0095956fca7b57e52` — the merge of head `743ac88b6ce187f37978cf549c3b63288a31d7b5` into base `5e706e7a9e938925de326ed52b6d65475f43d095`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin bfbecfe77b5507f481e0fbe0095956fca7b57e52 && git checkout bfbecfe77b5507f481e0fbe0095956fca7b57e52
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 5e706e7a9e938925de326ed52b6d65475f43d095 743ac88b6ce187f37978cf549c3b63288a31d7b5 && git checkout -B drift-repro 5e706e7a9e938925de326ed52b6d65475f43d095 && git merge --no-ff 743ac88b6ce187f37978cf549c3b63288a31d7b5

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 5e706e7a9e938925de326ed52b6d65475f43d095
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 5e706e7a9e938925de326ed52b6d65475f43d095` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 维护者速读（席位终稿 · head `e0253ce4`）

- **改了什么：** 规格里有了统一的“覆盖声明” `overrides: { package, basedOn }`，13 种元数据（视图、仪表盘、报表、页面、应用、流程、动作等）可以带上它，意思是“这一项整体替换 HotCRM 的同名项”。另外定下了配对定制包的规则：`hotcrm` 的定制包叫 `hotcrm.custom`，命名空间 `hotcrm_custom`，依赖 `^主版本`；哪些类型能覆盖是一张封闭清单；扩展字段用 `__c` 结尾；基础字段只允许改标签、说明、帮助文字、占位符和选项标签这几项显示属性。
- **为什么改：** 开发者在仓库里写的 `hotcrm.custom` 和管理员在 Studio 里做的定制，要落成同一份声明，后面的写入关、读取、导出和卸载才会读同一个东西。
- **风险与回滚：** 只加可选字段、常量和纯函数，还没有任何入口按它放行或拒绝，现有元数据不受影响。回退本 PR 即可。
- **先看：** `packages/spec/src/kernel/customization-package.ts`（类型清单和命名空间规则）、`packages/spec/src/data/field-customization.ts`（显示属性白名单）。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/kernel/override-declaration.test.ts src/kernel/customization-package.test.ts src/data/field-customization.test.ts`，三个文件全绿。
- **需要你做的：** 确认 PR 正文 "For the maintainer" 的 7 条（主要是：基础命名空间超过 13 个字符时不给定制包；`seed`、`datasource`、`tool`、`skill` 暂不允许覆盖）。确认之前不落地。

**席位意见：** ACCEPT（车道部分）。7 条都选了可以以后放宽的一侧：超长命名空间直接拒绝而不截断，4 个没定的类型先不允许覆盖。以后改成允许不会破坏已存的数据，反过来就会。

## 席位核对 · ACCEPT (lane part) · card #28404 (epic #28236 N-08) · 2026-10-31T20:25Z

1. **形态：** 88 files, +1912 / −21 at head `e0253ce45c`, draft, `Fixes #28404`, `Clause-②: yes (widening)` / `Metadata-protocol: added`, changeset `.changeset/28404-override-declaration.md` (`@objectstack/spec` minor). `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 28467`: NOT governed (the two `skills/**/references/_index.md` hits are pure regenerations, lifted). Tier S.
2. **前提实测：** holds. The seat read `override-declaration.zod.ts` (a leaf module importing only zod and `strictObject`, to avoid the manifest/app schema cycle), `customizationNamespace` (missing → `base_namespace_missing`; over `MAX_CUSTOMIZATION_BASE_NAMESPACE_LENGTH` = 13 → `base_namespace_too_long`; the pair judged against `ManifestSchema.shape.namespace`, so no grammar is restated), the range table (`^<major>` of the numeric core; `0.x` → `^0`) and `OVERRIDE_TYPE_CLASSIFICATION` (one table, total over `MetadataType`, pinned both ways to `DEFAULT_METADATA_TYPE_REGISTRY`). `overrides` is a separate spread, not part of `MetadataProtectionFields`, so excluded types do not gain it and registration/clone do not strip it as loader state.
3. **门禁 check-runs：** on `e0253ce45c` CI is running (13 success, 7 skipped, 22 in progress at 2026-10-31T20:25Z); the seat re-reads every check before any landing stroke. Dev: `dispatch-gates --commands` 112 derived, 112 run, all exit 0; `--ran` 112 of 112. Full spec suite 865 files / 24491 tests; spec and runtime typecheck 0; runtime export test 3/3. Two gate reds fixed in the branch (`check:llms-txt` counts; three existing pins given ledger rows). A reverse check (spread removed from `flow.zod.ts`) turns the strict `defineStack()` test red. os-dev-report 6548679183.
4. **接受的偏差：**
   - **The file surface grew past the claim**: 12 liveness ledgers (`planned` rows), `llms.txt`, two existing spec ledgers (`metadata-form-zod-reconciliation`, `flows-translation-face`) and a new runtime test. Each one was forced by a gate or a pin.
   - **The per-field patch slot on `ObjectExtensionSchema` rides N-23a**, as the order allowed: a slot the merge does not read would be an authorable key that nothing reads.
   - **`view` and `translation` carry the key on their item shapes only**: the `defineView` containers and locale bundles in `defineStack()` cannot carry it. Whether a container-level declaration fans out is a loader decision for the read and Studio cards.
   - **`basedOn` required inside the block** (both keys non-empty). This is maintainer item 7.
5. **范围外去向：** the export skips `emailTemplates` (pre-existing, before this PR) → the effective-read card N-10; cloning an overriding `.custom` flow copies `overrides` → N-21; container fan-out → the read and Studio children of #28236. All are carried by existing epic children, so no new card is filed. **`Skills-docs:`** none owed yet: no door reads the declaration, so the skill lands with the write gate and read doors.
6. **落地条款：** Tier S path. Owed before any landing stroke: the maintainer's confirmation of the 7 "For the maintainer" items (a changed answer means a new head and a delta review); green CI on the landing head; a same-shape `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` PASS (`packages/spec/src/**` non-test). This seat cannot serve that tier now and hands the review over below.

### ① Ruling → code

- D3, the pair: `.custom` suffix spelled once (`CUSTOMIZATION_PACKAGE_SUFFIX` in the leaf, re-read by the helpers); `customizationPackageId` judged by `MANIFEST_ID_PATTERN`, `customizationBasePackageId` the exact inverse, `isCustomizationPairOf` the ruling-A predicate; `customizationNamespace` `<base_ns>_custom`, judged by `ManifestSchema.shape.namespace`, 13-character limit derived from the grammar and pinned; `customizationDependencyRange` `^<major>` from the SemVer core. Every derivation a discriminated result, no throw, no truncation, no hashing.

- Not here, as the card's "Not here": no door (N-09 / N-10 / N-13 / N-14 / N-23a/b).

### ② Declarations
- `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and `Metadata-protocol: added`, `@objectstack/spec` minor, on the PR and in the changeset: right for an optional new key on thirteen schemas plus new kernel / data exports. No ADR-0087 marker owed (no key moves).
